title: The Pink Bunny Halloween Costume
intro: The bunny costume is the one everybody remembers and almost nobody pulls off, because the bagged versions look like a party store on a bad day. This one starts with a real pink corset mini dress you would happily wear again in December, then lets the ears, the bow tie collar, the cuffs and a fluffy heart bag do the costume part. Fuchsia suede platforms and pink pearl drops finish it. Take the ears off and you are dressed for dinner, which is exactly how a costume should behave.
